preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 2 * 10**5 for N, M in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of provinces N is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= M <= min(N * (N - 1) // 2, 3 * 10**5) for N, M in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of destroyed roads M is between 0 and the minimum of N*(N-1)/2 or 300,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == M for N, M, edges in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of edges provided matches M.

preconditions.expression: all(u != v for u, v in edges for N, M, edges in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, no edge connects a province to itself.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges for N, M, edges in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, all provinces in edges are between 1 and N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(edges.count((u, v)) == 1 and edges.count((v, u)) == 1 for u, v in edges for N, M, edges in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, all edges are unique and undirected (no duplicates).

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(answer, int) and answer >= 0 for answer in answers)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a non-negative integer representing the number of valid ways to deploy the senas.

postconditions.expression: all(len(answers) == T)
postconditions.description: The number of answers matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(X) <= N - 1 and 1 <= len(Y) <= N - 1 for X, Y in valid_deployments)
postconditions.description: For each valid deployment, there is at least one province with Sena X and at least one with Sena Y.

postconditions.expression: all(all(not (u in X and v in X) for u, v in complete_graph_edges if (u, v) not in destroyed_edges) for X, Y in valid_deployments)
postconditions.description: For each valid deployment, no two adjacent provinces (connected by a non-destroyed road) are both in Sena X.

postconditions.expression: all(all(any(u in X for u in X) for v in Y) for X, Y in valid_deployments)
postconditions.description: For each valid deployment, every province in Sena Y is adjacent to at least one province in Sena X.

postconditions.expression: all(len(X) + len(Y) == N for X, Y in valid_deployments)
postconditions.description: For each valid deployment, all provinces are assigned to either Sena X or Sena Y.

postconditions.expression: all(X != set() and Y != set() for X, Y in valid_deployments)
postconditions.description: For each valid deployment, there is at least one province in Sena X and at least one in Sena Y.

postconditions.expression: all(len(X) + len(Y) == N for X, Y in valid_deployments)
postconditions.description: For each valid deployment, all provinces are assigned to either Sena X or Sena Y.

postconditions.expression: all(len(X) >= 1 and len(Y) >= 1 for X, Y in valid_deployments)
postconditions.description: For each valid deployment, there is at least one province in Sena X and at least one in Sena Y.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for X, Y in valid_deployments if X == x and Y == y) == count for x, y, count in answer_counts)
